posts.caption:
surprised my dad with his dream truck…. 

GOD IS GOOD⁣⁣ 🙏🏾

today is the biggest day of my career so far 

my app @tryviralvault was acquired by @autods_tools 

i’ve been building this since 2018 and it’s been the most challenging thing i’ve ever done… 

this business brought me down to my lowest.

back in 2020 i racked up $30,000 in debt trying to build it… 

since then we’ve helped over 50,000 people start their first online stores all over the world

all thanks to my amazing team & community who rode with me through the entire journey… 

and to everyone who used the app over the years 

i appreciate each and every one of you 🤞🏾❤️

now with @autods_tools we have everything we need to reach the next level & help thousands more 🔓

Bought my mom her dream house today 🙏🏽❤️

And it’s crazy bc our first house was from a government housing program called habitat for humanity, my mom had to help build 100 houses for them to help us get a mortgage… 

We never went without anything she always sacrificed it all for us just so we can have a great life, so she deserves it all.

Work hard so you can take care of yours 🤞🏾
walk with the wise & become wise
